page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.48xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server type hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz, delivering 192 dedicated virtual cores. System memory totals 768.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 processor-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per vCPU.

The instance does not integrate local storage, which requires external network-attached volumes for operating systems and persistent data. Graphics processing hardware is absent with 0 GPUs. For networking, it features a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating high volumes of inter-node data traffic. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

With its 192 dedicated physical-threaded allocations and balanced memory configuration, ecs.g9i.48xlarge provides high resource density for horizontal compute scaling. The hardware profile is aligned with parallel batch tasks, large-scale web services, in-memory cache clusters, continuous integration systems, and enterprise back-end infrastructure.
